task_description: Create a complete admin dashboard in /admin/ subdirectory with 6 PHP pages: index.php (dashboard summary), alumnos.php (student CRUD), tutores.php (tutor CRUD), asistencias.php (attendance history), usuarios.php (system users CRUD), dispositivos.php (FCM tokens management). All pages share consistent sidebar navigation, auth checks, and the project's visual design system.

verification.summary: All 6 PHP files pass syntax check (php -l). All files contain: session_start(), auth check for usuario_autenticado, require_once '../conexion.php', sidebar navigation with links to all 6 pages, Tailwind CDN, Google Fonts, project color palette. No MySQL runtime available for functional testing.
